proposal: ASME Section I with PED module G; EN 12952-3 for fatigue of thick-walled parts; HEI 12th edition; CO2 per NFPA 12; SL2; IEC deliverables 30 days before each apply-by date.
question: The codes and standards register (Appendix A.19, proposed to the Owner in TQ-033) names IEC as responsible for 62 entries (power island design, tests, Turkish regulations applicable to the IEC supply). Please confirm compliance back-to-back and state any deviation, in particular: (1) ER-06.02 allows ASME Section I or EN 12952 - which code, which PED module; ER-06.05 cites EN 12952-3 for the cyclic assessment; (2) HEI edition for the condenser (ER-07.07: 11th or later); (3) GT enclosure fire protection (ER-10.05: water mist or CO2); (4) IEC 62443 SL2 for the TCS. (5) Confirm the IEC deliverables for the permits PMT-004, 005, 008, 009, 013, 014, 015, 016, 018 and 021 with the dates of the permits register.
response: Confirmed back-to-back for all entries naming IEC, with: (1) HRSG to ASME Section I, PED module G by a notified body; EN 12952-3 for the low-cycle fatigue of the HP drum and SH/RH outlet headers; (2) HEI 12th edition; (3) GT enclosure CO2 total flooding per NFPA 12; (4) TCS system SL2 (IEC 62443-3-3) with certified components; please add ISO 20816-2 for the vibration limits of the turbines and generators. (5) IEC deliverables for the permits 30 days before each apply-by date of the permits register: generator/GSU data and models (PMT-004, PMT-021), foundation loads (PMT-005), heavy piece list and transport drawings (PMT-008, PMT-009), NDT source licences of IEC's site subcontractors (PMT-013), GT gas demand (PMT-014), inventories (PMT-015), declarations of conformity and notified body certificates (PMT-016), GT emission data (PMT-018).
subject: Codes and standards back-to-back, and IEC deliverables for permits
